purpose: Sanitized records of real application executions on the dedicated Vultr VM
sanitization: Allowlisted runtime, model, token, hash, result, executed-code and event fields. No account, billing, support, credential or access-code data. Private call-budget counters omitted.
integrity_note: Hashes identify files and inputs; these application receipts are not signed provider attestations. Provider model identifiers are reported values, not independent verification of model weights or hardware.

boundary_audit.sanitization: Ephemeral job capability IDs removed; account, credential and administrative details absent.
